Independent Claude review of SCREEN_SONG_PILOT_20261014. I fetched all 8 cited URLs myself (not just status-checked) and all 4 keyed facts are factually TRUE against primary sources once actually read; but the submission has a process-integrity problem plus two quality issues, so REWORK, not accept.

1) EVIDENCE INTEGRITY (critical): research.json shows only 3/8 fetches succeeded (status 200) and 5 timed out (status null, 0 bytes). Yet editorial.json's sources[] still asserts confident one-line evidence for all 5 failed fetches as if read, and REPORT.json reports source_fetch_count:8 without disclosing the 5/8 failure rate. I independently re-fetched the 5 failed URLs with plain urllib; they ARE reachable and DO support the claims, but the writer could not have known that at submission time and must not report 8/8 as fetched when only 3/8 succeeded.

2) Q3 ambiguity/giveaway: stem contains the title 'ONE SHOT' and the key is 'one continuous take' - a strong semantic hint. Distractor (d) 'animated film' is implausible on its face. Recommend rewriting stem to avoid the title cue and replacing the animated-film distractor.

3) Q2 taxonomy mismatch: options mix major/minor (tonal center) with pentatonic (scale type) and twelve-tone (compositional technique) as if parallel - pedagogically confusing even though 'minor' is factually correct.

4) Minor unverified distractor claim: q4 distractor_rationale option (c) states Luis Almau is listed as co-producer - this name does not appear in either fetched Train Dreams source.

5) Dedup is exact-match only; PROMPT_EN.md flags this as weaker than semantic dedup, and REPORT.json does not disclose that limitation plainly.

Positive notes: key balance correct (a,b,c,d once each); word counts 154-160 in range; no literal \n escapes; the 3 successfully-fetched sources directly support their claims (parle-chante bridge per Cyril Holtz; minor-key intro per Bobbie-Jane Gardner; Nick Cave wrote lyrics/melody over Dessner's idea).

Requested fixes: (a) re-fetch the 5 timed-out sources and confirm evidence fields with text actually read; (b) correct REPORT.json's fetch-success reporting; (c) revise Q3 stem/distractor; (d) replace Q2's mixed scale/technique options with parallel tonal-center options; (e) cite or drop the Luis Almau claim; (f) flag dedup as exact-match-only pending semantic check.
